title: Normal Chip H3K23ac Control
author: N.G Martin, Hugo
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Fix cells with formaldehyde
steps.instruction: After isolation, resuspend 1 × 10⁶ cells in appropriate buffer and add formaldehyde to a final concentration of 1 % (v/v); incubate for 14 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Quench fixation with glycine
steps.instruction: Add glycine to a final concentration of 125 mM to the fixed cells and incubate for an additional 1 minute to quench the reaction.

steps.title: Wash cells and harvest
steps.instruction: Wash the quenched cells three times with PBS containing complete protease inhibitor cocktail (Roche, cat 11836145001) and 10 mM sodium butyrate (Sigma‑Aldrich, cat 303410); then scrape the cells from the plates to harvest them.

steps.title: Isolate nuclei with Covaris
steps.instruction: Transfer the harvested cells to a Covaris E220 tube and sonicate for 4.5 minutes at peak power 75 W, duty factor 2 % and 200 cycles/burst to isolate nuclei.

steps.title: Immunoprecipitate chromatin
steps.instruction: For each IP, add 2 µg of the specific antibody and protein A/G Dynabeads (Thermo Scientific, cat 88802) to an equal amount of chromatin per sample; incubate under the conditions described in Arrigoni 2018 (no barcode ligation or pooling).

steps.title: Quantify chromatin concentration
steps.instruction: Measure the concentration of the input chromatin using a Nanodrop spectrophotometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

steps.title: Quantify immunoprecipitated DNA
steps.instruction: Determine the amount of DNA recovered from the IP with a Qubit 4 Fluorometer (Thermo Scientific) before proceeding to library preparation.

steps.title: Prepare sequencing libraries
steps.instruction: Construct libraries from the immunoprecipitated DNA using the NEBNext Ultra library preparation kit (New England Biolabs, cat E7645S) following the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Assess library quality and quantity
steps.instruction: Evaluate each library on a BioAnalyzer (Agilent) to check fragment size distribution and quantify the library concentration.

steps.title: Sequence libraries on NovaSeq
steps.instruction: Load the qualified libraries onto an Illumina NovaSeq instrument and run a 150‑bp paired‑end sequencing run.
